tytul: Akcje serwisowe aut w UE – tydzień 43/2026: Peugeot, Fiat, Opel/Vauxhall, CITROEN
lead: Wezwania samochodów do serwisu zgłoszone w unijnym systemie Safety Gate w 43. tygodniu 2026 r. – 7 pozycji.
tresc:
## Do uzupełnienia

Szkic bez tekstu – brak klucza modelu językowego. Opisy usterek poniżej są po angielsku: przetłumacz je w panelu przed publikacją.

zrodla.nazwa: Safety Gate – raport tygodniowy Report-2026-43 (Komisja Europejska)

pozycje.problem: On vehicles with a 2.2L diesel engine, insufficient tightening of the fuel pressure damper may create a gap in the assembly and cause diesel to leak from the fuel system. If the leaking fuel comes into contact with an ignition source, it could ignite and cause a fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 08/10/2026

pozycje.problem: Moisture ingress in the steering rack area may cause corrosion of a steering rack bolt. As a result, the bolt could fracture and lead to a loss of steering capability, increasing the risk of an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 14/10/2026

pozycje.problem: The front seat belts may be incorrectly secured to the lower anchorage points. This could impair their restraining function in the event of a collision, increasing the risk of injury. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ImporterCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 15/10/2026

pozycje.problem: The propellant in the driver and front passenger airbags may deteriorate over time. If the airbags deploy, it could result in fragments from the inflator injuring the vehicle's occupants. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
